Name: Em and Harry's Capybara
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
[b][size=3]What's everyone's favorite super chill, semi-aquatic, giant rodent?  It's the Capybara![/size][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/67153256-1754933188.gif[/img]
﻿Introducing Em and Harry's [b]Capybara[/b], a new barn animal.  Intended as a late game unlockable, the Capybara is purchasable at Marnie's after fulfilling a Special Order requiring Island ingredients and it costs 25,000g.
﻿What does it do?  On sunny days when the Capybara can leave the barn and roam, it will leave foragable items in the barn for you.  What specifically it forages is based on your choice of farm cave; if you've chosen the [b]Fruit Bats[/b], the Capybara leaves a variety of [b]mushrooms[/b]; if you've chosen [b]Mushroom Boxes[/b], the Capybara leaves a variety of [b]tree fruit[/b] (if, for whatever reason, your Farm Cave is set to [b]None[/b], the Capybara will produce [b]both[/b]) ; either way, you will receive one a day on sunny days during Spring, Summer, and Fall.  Doesn't sound like much for a difficult to obtain, and frankly not too cheap, animal?  That's because the Capybara has one more effect: it's so chill and friendly that on the days it goes outside, it [b]automatically pets[/b] all your other Barn and Coop animals on the Farm.  The Capybara is thus an alternative to the Auto-Petter that is more reliably obtainable, if a little less consistent in use.

[b]Config Options[/b]
﻿For game balance and internal logic purposes, the Capybara is only available post-Ginger Island.  However, you can choose whether it becomes available automatically or if you must unlock it through a Special Order.  You can change this with the "[b]CapybaraUnlock[/b]" option in the config.json (or through the in game menu with Generic Mod Config Options).
﻿"[i]SpecialOrder[/i]": a Special Order requiring island crops must be completed before Marnie will sell Capybaras
﻿"[i]IslandFarm[/i]": after reaching the Island West location for the first time, Marnie will announce she will be selling Capybaras
﻿
﻿Due to the Marnie dropbox occasionally running into interference with other mods, I've also added an option for "[b]SpecialOrderDropbox[/b]":
﻿"[i]Marnie[/i]": the Special Order uses Marnie's fridge as a dropbox
﻿"[i]Pierre[/i]": Marnie asks you to drop off the items at the dropbox at Pierre's for safe keeping

[b]Install[/b]
﻿Inside the zip is two folders, [b]Capybara[/b] and [b]Capybara [CP][/b].  Both are required, as the Capybara [CP] adds the Capybara through Content Patcher, while Capybara contains a C# mod enabling the Capybara's auto-pet feature.
﻿[i]Please note[/i]: at the moment, the Capybara will only pet farm animals on the Farm, not at other locations.  This is my first C# mod and I do not yet know how to program that function.  I intend to keep learning and to eventually update this mod so that the Capybara pets all animals at a location that has a Capybara.  [url=https://github.com/HarrisonGrey/StardewCapybara]My source code is on GitHub[/url]; if you know how to achieve this and would like to help, feel free to comment or DM me.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url] compatible; the Capybaras will produce on custom weather that still allows the animals to go outside.
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20910]Farm Cave Framework[/url] compatible; because of changes Farm Cave Framework mods make to the Farm Cave produce, if you have Farm Cave Framework, then the Capybaras produce both mushrooms [i]and[/i] tree fruit.
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia[/url] compatible; Cornucopia's Artisan Machines mod makes a special order dropbox out of Marnie's fridge, which this mod will use for its special order.

[b]Credits[/b]
﻿This mod is a collaboration between Em and myself.  Em did the wonderful artwork, check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rivalrabbit?gameId=1303&pk_vid=ee7f4ab151b402271754632713eb649d]her other mods and reskins[/url]!  I could not have done the coding without the help of modding community at the Stardew discord.
﻿Also, thank you to 180nw for the Chinese translation.
